Md. Azad Khan @ Azad Khan vs The State Of Jharkhand on 15
September, 2023

1
 In The Supreme Court Of India
 Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction
 Criminal Appeal No. Of 2023
 (arising out of Slp (Crl.) No. 2073 of 2023)
 Md. Azad Khan @ Azad Khan ..... A
 Versus
 State Of Jharkhand & Anr. ..... Re
 O R D E R
Leave granted.
Notice was served by the appellant - Md. Azad Khan @ Azad Khan on respondent no. 2  Benzir Khannam through the dasti mode.
However, appearance has not been entered on behalf of respondent no. 2  Benzir Khannam.
Heard the learned counsel appearing on behalf of the appellant  Md. Azad Khan @ Azad Khan and respondent no. 1 - State of Jharkhand.

We have perused the impugned judgment/order of the Jharkhand High Court, at Ranchi, dated 18.04.2022, which grants anticipatory bail to the appellant  Md. Azad Khan @ Azad Khan in First Information Report No. 161 of 2021 registered at Police Station  Lower Bazar, Sub-Division Sadar,
Ranchi, Jharkhand, for the offence punishable under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 1.

entities.text:
Police Station  Lower Bazar, Sub-Division Sadar,
Ranchi
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
The impugned judgment/order, while granting benefit of anticipatory bail to the appellant  Md.
Azad Khan @ Azad Khan, has imposed the condition that the appellant - Md. Azad Khan @ Azad Khan should pay 1 For short, IPC.
Rs.2,00,000/-(rupees two lakh only) as an ad interim victim compensation to respondent no. 2  Benzir Khannam, without any prejudice to his case.
We are inclined to modify the aforesaid condition imposed by the High Court.
It is an accepted position that the appellant - Md. Azad Khan @ Azad Khan is cooperating with the investigation.
